about_the_game:
Left By Angels - Based on the real Left By Angels Mansion

A descent into guilt, grief, and the unknown.

After your wife vanishes without explanation, her face resurfaces—captured in the shattered window of a long-abandoned mansion by urban explorers. The footage makes national headlines. You follow the only lead you have.

But something is wrong.

The building isn’t in ruins… It’s pristine. Alive. Trapped inside, you uncover echoes of a life you thought was gone, twisted and changed. She is here. She speaks. And she demands answers.

Why did you do this?

Experience a dark, story-driven psychological horror where nothing is what it seems, and everything is personal. Step into a nightmare shaped by regret and deceit, where the past refuses to stay buried.

Key Features

First-Person Psychological Horror – Explore a richly detailed world through a deeply immersive perspective. Discover, survive, and confront what you’re not ready to face.

Light is Survival – Use your flashlight and limited battery supply to navigate pitch-black corridors. Capture moments and uncover hidden truths with your photo camera.

Puzzles and Exploration – Solve environmental puzzles, discover secrets, and piece together a broken story through exploration and memory fragments.

Looping Reality – The mansion changes with every step. Time loops, rooms shift, and logic breaks.

A Haunting Story – She knows everything. Relive what she endured. Walk through her pain. Unravel the truth—layer by disturbing layer.

Left By Angels is a narrative-driven horror experience blending supernatural elements, environmental storytelling, and surreal loops to deliver a terrifying and emotional journey through guilt and revelation.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains mature horror content: blood, gore, death, and scary moments.

  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 with 4GB VRAM ／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti with 4GB VRAM

short_description: Based on the real Left By Angels Mansion! After your wife vanishes, a strange sighting draws you to an abandoned mansion. Trapped inside, haunted by the past, and hunted by truth, you must survive a looping nightmare where light is your only ally. She’s here—and she remembers everything.
